players.product: Power-secured HPC/AI data-center lease campuses (Lake Mariner NY for Fluidstack/Google; Justified & Muskie KY) - ex-Bitcoin-mining conversion

connects_to.relationship: Justified Data Campus (Hawesville, KY) critical IT capacity leased directly to Anthropic on a 20-year lease

contracts.signal: TeraWulf subsidiary Raylan Data LLC (landlord) entered into a 20-year lease with Anthropic PBC (tenant) providing approximately 401 MW of critical IT load for HPC operations at the Justified Data Campus in Hawesville, Kentucky. Delivery is expected in phases beginning in late 2027 and concluding in early 2028; rent starts on delivery of the applicable leased premises and runs 20 years, with Anthropic holding two successive five-year renewal options, and Anthropic's payment obligations are expected to be supported by an investment-grade credit. The press release puts the lease at approximately $19 billion of contracted lease revenue over the initial term.
contracts.units: approximately 401 MW of critical IT load
